Commentary.Commentary: So, it is confirmed that Prince  Masvaure will have a new opening partner in Brian Mudzinganyama for Zimbabwe.

Now then, just under a session and a full day is what Zimbabwe will have to play out to save the Test. The wicket is still not bad but yes, it is misbehaving but just a little. They will be without their opener who showed a lot of promise in the first innings. Not sure who will be replacing him but everybody has to dig in. Around 17 overs left in the day, the hosts' first target will be to play this out unscathed or with minimal damage. The visitors on the other hand will be eager to get at least a couple of wickets in this final hour.

The Zimbabwe bowlers did not do a lot wrong! They bowled the correct lines and lengths but there was hardly any purchase for their seamers and spinners. Victor Nyauchi impressed a lot with a three-fer. Tiripano and Jarvis were also decent. Williams and Raza finished with five combined.

There were contributions from most of the Lankan batters like the openers got off to starts, Mendis missed out on a ton by around 20 runs, Dickwella and Dhananjaya de Silva scored half tons. However, it was Angelo Mathews who was the star for them with a double ton. It was him who anchored the innings and took the Lankans to a massive score.

The umpires have called for Drinks but guess what? SRI LANKA HAVE FINALLY DECLARED! So almost after two days of batting, the visitors' innings comes to an end. They have a massive lead of 157 and they have batted themselves into a position from where they can't lose the game.

On a very slow third day, Angelo Mathews led the charge for Sri Lanka with the bat. With an unbeaten 92 and an unbeaten 68-run stand with Dhananjaya de Silva, he has taken Sri Lanka's total close to the final score of Zimbabwe. Regarding the situation of this Test match, Sri Lanka have slowly but surely closed the gap with Zimbabwe. They concentrated on building partnerships since the morning session and managed to construct quite a few. Angelo Mathews was the nucleus around which everyone revolved. Earlier, Kusal Mendis showed a lot of patience and character in his knock but fell short of his century. His stand though put Sri Lanka on the front foot and post his departure and the flop show from Dinesh Chandimal, Dhananjaya de Silva combined with Mathews to take Sri Lanka to Stumps without further casualty.

End of yet another day of old-fashioned Test cricket! It was a real grind for everyone. Runs and wickets came at a premium with both teams trying their best to execute their plans and skills. With little to no support from the surface, the Zimbabwean bowlers should be credited for continuously coming hard at the batsmen and their skipper, Sean Williams was also quite enterprising with his field setting. All in all, it was a day for Test cricket purists.

OUT! Caught! Yes, it did hit the boot straight so Chandimal has to go. Zimbabwe celebrate. Chandimal is not happy but he has to depart. A fullish ball around middle and leg, Chandimal skips down the track and looks to flick but the ball takes the bottom edge and then lobs towards the bowler. The Zimbabwean skipper catches it and appeals. The umpires get together and refer it upstairs with the soft signal as not out. Now, the replays roll in. It looks like the ball hit the boot directly and not the turf and then it ballooned towards the bowler. The third umpire takes his time and checks different angles. There's very limited technology in this Test series. Eventually, Langton Rusere feels that there are clear shreds of evidence to overturn the soft call. Another good looking stand has been broken. Still no signs of the second new ball. Sean Williams to continue...
FOUR! Cut away! Short and wide outside off, Chandimal goes back and cuts it through point for his first boundary.
Back of a length ball on middle, Chandimal ducks under it.

Edgy runs! A full ball just outside off, Chandimal looks to defend but the ball takes the outside edge and goes between the slip and gully fielders. Before the fielder can chase the ball, a couple of runs are taken.

Shortish and around off, Chandimal keeps it out.

Confusion but safe in the end. Full ball around off, Chandimal pushes it back past the bowler. He wants a single and he is off for it in a flash. Mathews though is ball-watching with his hand up to say no. Chandimal does not see that initially and keeps coming towards the non-striker's end. However, before the mid on fielder can get to the ball and throw it to the keeper, Chandimal has realized it and has enough time to get back safely.
Donald Tiripano is back on. 14-3-30-1 are his figures so far. No new ball taken yet! Maybe, a few balls to warm-up and then they will opt for it.
Flatter and on middle and leg, pushed towards mid-wicket. Second new ball is available now!
SIX! Hammered! A loopy ball around off, Mathews picks it off his pads and sends it sailing over the long on fence for a biggie. Second six of the innings for Mathews.
Flatter ball outside off, Mathews looks to defend but misses.
Flatter and outside off, cut to the man at point.
Fires it down the leg side. Mathews looks to flick but misses. The keeper there does well to pouch the ball with a move to his left.
Shortish length ball on middle, Mathews punches it to mid on off the back foot.
Another ball which is angled into the batter, Mathews works it behind square leg for a single.
Good length ball angled in, Mathews keeps it out.
Good length ball around off, it is defended.
Full ball on middle, firmly driven to mid on once again.
Good length ball on off, pushed to mid on by Mathews.
Full ball on middle, Mathews strokes it to mid on.
Flatter ball on off, Chandimal keeps it out lunging forward.
On off, it is defended.
Another full ball around off, pushed to mid off again.
Flatter ball around off, it is defended off the back foot.
Floated ball around off, Mathews strokes it to mid off for a single.
Full ball around off, pushed to mid off.

In the channel outside off, left alone.
Full delivery on off, Mathews drives it through mid off. Prince Masvaure chases it, slides and does well to pull it back just before the rope. The batsmen get three runs.
Good length delivery on off, Mathews defends it off the front foot.

Victor Nyauchi to bowl from the other end. 19-6-32-3 from him so far.

Floated delivery on off, Chandimal punches it to point.

We are back for the final session of Day 3. The players are out in the middle. Angelo Mathews and Dinesh Chandimal will resume their batting for Sri Lanka. Sean Williams will start the proceedings for the final session...
... Day 3, Session 3 ...

Another absorbing session of this Test match comes to a close. 81/1 in the 31 overs bowled! Both teams fared decently. Neither Zimbabwe allowed Sri Lanka to run away by scoring quickly nor the Lankans gave away more than a wicket to the African minnows. The pitch is as dead as a dodo and there's nothing happening. Waiting game is what these two teams are playing with both testing out each other's patience. The deficit is now down to 153 runs and the hosts are quickly running out of runs in the bank. Do join us in a short while for the evening session as another 31 'entertaining' overs are left in the day's play.
Another good length ball around off, it is defended. AND THAT WILL BE TEA ON DAY 3.
Another length ball around off, easily negotiated by Mathews.
Length ball on off, Mathews presents straight bat to defend it out.
Full and outside off, Mathews looks to drive but the ball takes the bottom edge and rolls towards covers.
Shortish and around off, it is tapped towards mid off.
HALF TON FOR MATHEWS! 35th in Tests for him. It has been a hard-fought one for the senior most Lankan batter. He gets there by flicking this ball towards deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Flatter delivery on off, Mathews plays a late cut wide of first slip and takes a single.
SIX! A scoring opportunity there and Mathews makes full use of it. A rank full toss around off, Angelo bends his back knee a bit and smokes it over mid-wicket. 200 comes up for Sri Lanka!
Loopy and full on off, Mathews pushes it with an angled bat to cover-point.
Mathews has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Too full in length on middle, pushed back in the direction of the bowler.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.

NEARLY A DRAG ON! The bowler delivers a length ball but pitches it wide outside off. Mathews tries to latch onto the room and smash it through the line but it takes the inside edge and beats the stumps by a whisker.
Lands it on a length and around off, angling in, Angelo meets it with a dead bat and pushes it out to short cover.
Flicks a full ball across the line but finds one of the two short mid-wicket fielders.
Puts it in the line of the off stump, Mathews brings down a straight bat and defends it from the middle.
Slight inward movement off the deck. It's on a length close to off, Mathews moves back to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Fires in a fuller length ball close to off, Mathews strides forward and defends it off the inner half to short mid-wicket.
Chandimal has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Loopy and full on middle, DC presses forward and blocks it back to the bowler.
Loopy full ball around off, Chandimal drives but finds short cover.
A full toss on off, pushed towards deepish mid on for a run.
Flattish and shortish on off, punched from the back foot to covers.
Flighted ball on middle, defended off the inner half to short mid-wicket.
Full and on middle, Mathews pushes it down the ground. The man at mid on dives to his right and makes a save. A single taken.

Overthrow! A fuller ball outside off, Mathews pushes it towards point and a quick single is taken. The point fielder gets to the ball, picks it up and fires the throw at the striker's end. He misses and the ball goes towards square leg and an extra run is taken.
Slightly fuller and outside off, this is pushed towards covers.
Full ball around off, Mathews strokes it well but straight to mid off.
Full and around off, it is defended.

Full and around off, it is defended.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Loopy ball on middle, it is stroked towards mid off and a quick run is taken. The fielder there picks the ball and throws at the non-striker's end but misses.
Floated ball around off and middle, Mathews keeps it out.
Around off and middle, it is defended.
Low full toss on middle, Chandimal strokes it towards mid on where the fielder fumbles and the batters get an extra. Three taken.
Full ball just outside off, Mathews pushes it towards gully.
Another length ball around off, Mathews taps it to the man at covers.
Good length ball around off and middle, Mathews defends it nicely.
Full and on middle, it is pushed towards mid on.
Shortish and around off, Mathews taps it towards point for nothing.
Good length ball around off, it is defended off the front foot by Mathews.
On off and middle, full too. It is worked to the man at mid-wicket.
Slightly short one on middle, Chandimal pushes it back to the bowler.
Floats it on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and on middle, Mathews strokes it to long off for a run.
Floated ball on off, Mathews comes forward and defends it out.
Flatter ball on middle, Chandimal works it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Landed on middle, worked towards mid-wicket. End of a successful over for Zimbabwe.
Good length ball around off, it is defended.
RIPPER! A length ball angled into the right-hander. It comes back in sharply as Mathews looks to defend but the ball goes through with the angle and beats the inside edge.
Slightly short of a length ball on the body, Chandimal works it towards fine leg to get off the mark.
Dinesh Chandimal is the new batsman. He hurt his fingers yesterday but it looks like he has recovered from that injury and fit to bat.

OUT! Caught! The stand is broken and Mendis is the man who departs. A century was on offer for Mendis but he has thrown it away. A full ball outside off, Mendis had been leaving these deliveries so far but this time he is lured into the shot. He goes for the drive away from his body. The ball takes the thick outside edge and goes straight to Taylor at first slip. He does not make any mistake there and Zimbabwe have the much-needed wicket. Sri Lanka still 173 runs behind.
Length ball angled into the pads, Mendis works it to the leg side.
Loopy ball on off, Mathews pushes it to the left of the bowler who dives to that side and parries the ball towards covers.
Another full toss, this is around of, pushed back to the bowler.
Very full ball around off, Mathews digs it out to mid off.
Another ball in the line of the stumps, it is defended.
On off, It is defended back to the bowler.
Full toss on middle and leg, Mendis sweeps it for a run to deep square leg.
On middle, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
Another fuller ball, this is outside off, Mathews drives it well but finds the fielder at cover.
Full ball around off, Mathews strokes it straight to mid off.
Good length ball just outside off, Mathews pushes it to covers.

Length ball around off, it is defended.
Quicker and shorter ball around off, Mendis stays on the back foot and pushes it to long on for a single.
Fires it wide outside off, Mendis guides it towards third man and takes a single.
Flatter one on off, it is worked towards the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Short and punished! A half-tracker and it is on middle, Mathews goes on the back foot and pulls it to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Around off, it is defended.
Quick couple! Ndlovu starts the spell with a ball on the pads, Mathews helps it to fine leg and scampers back for a couple of runs.

Length ball around off, Mendis keeps it out off his back foot.

Length ball just around off, keeping a touch low. Mendis gets his bat down in time to work it towards mid-wicket.

Length ball around off, Mendis pushes it towards covers.

Floated ball around off, it is defended.
Full ball around off and middle, Mendis strokes it to long on for a run.

FOUR! Swept nicely! Full ball around off, Mendis sits down and sweeps it to the deep mid-wicket fence. The fielder there dives to his right to save but he fails to do so.
On off, it is defended.
Full and outside off, Mathews pushes it to mid off for a single.
On middle, worked towards the leg side.
Good length ball around off, Mendis keeps it out off his back foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full ball around off, Mendis comes forward and keeps it out.
Full and around off, pushed towards covers.

DRINKS! Another wicket-less hour for the hosts. They have been working really hard out in the middle but are unable to break this stubborn stand between Mendis and Mathews. The two have got their eyes in and would look to score big knocks and keep taking the side forward. Interesting passage of play awaits.
Another ball around off, it is defended.
Flights this one and lands it around off, worked towards mid-wicket.

Good length ball around off, Mathews defends it off his front foot.
In the channel outside off, it is left alone.

Full ball on off, Mathews strokes it to long off for a single.

Good length ball on off, worked towards mid-wicket.

Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Very full and around leg, Mathews plays the on drive but finds mid on.

Presses forward to a full ball and defends it back to the bowler.
Shortish ball on off, skidding in, Mendis goes back and pushes it to short cover.
This one is pitched up again by Jarvis, Mathews plays a well-timed drive but finds mid off.
Lands it very full and close to off, Mathews prods forward and defends it back from the bottom half of his bat.
A mistimed pull shot! Short in length around off, Mathews turns to pull but mistimes it towards one of the two short mid-wicket fielders.
On a length and close to off, Angelo remains on the back foot and defends it to the off side.
Pitches it up and outside off, Mathews drives confidently off his front foot but finds the cover fielder.
Good length delivery outside off, holding its line, Mathews shoulders arms.

Welcome back for the afternoon session. The players who matter are back on the field. A customary huddle for Zimbabwe as Sean Williams shares some words with his boys that he forgot to share in the dressing room. Now, they spread on the field. Angelo Mathews and Kusal Mendis are dragging themselves to the middle. Kyle Jarvis to continue his spell from this end. Here we go again.
... DAY 3, SECOND SESSION ...

A real grind! For everyone. 82/1 in the 30 overs bowled in the morning. Dimuth Karunaratne and Kusal Mendis started solidly and then took their partnership over fifty runs. Then, against the run of play, Victor Nyauchi managed to get a breakthrough as he removed the Lankan skipper at the stroke of first hour. Post that, Kusal Mendis has combined with Angelo Mathews and together they didn't allow any more success to the home team. There were some nervy moments, mainly for Mathews, but he survived those and would be hoping to make  merry in the afternoon. Zimbabwe have bowled well with little to no support from the surface. They still have a 234-run lead in their pocket but will have to spend it carefully. Hoping for yet another absorbing session in a short while. Do join us.
Full and flighted on off, Mendis is on the front foot again as he defends it. LUNCH ON DAY 3!
Leans forward to a full ball and defends it solidly.
Flighted and around off, Kusal eases himself on the back foot in defense.
Mendis has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Once again Williams is on the shorter side, Mendis punches it from the back foot but finds mid-wicket.

Physio comes out! Initially Kevin Kasuza gave a thumbs up but is now feeling the after effects. That has shook him and he is on his haunches. Mandatory concussion test will be carried out. In fact, Kasuza is leaving the field for some medical attention. This should be the last over of the session also.

Ouch, that would have hurt short leg! Short in length and on middle, Mendis rocks back to pull but it hits Kevin Kasuza flush on the helmet as he tries to duck. The ball deflects to fine leg and they cross for a couple of runs.
Pitches it up and around off, forcing the batsman to drive, Angelo does that but in full control this time. Although he picks out short cover again. Good probing over by Jarvis.
A little short this time, around off, Mathews gets the opportunity to go on the back foot and defend it back to the bowler.
Around off, on a length, Mathews defends it from the crease to the off side.
Jarvis goes even fuller and pitches it around off, Mathews drives through the line with a hesitant footwork and hits it a bit aerially. Doesn't carry to short cover.
Once again Jarvis keeps his line close to off, this time Mathews covers the delivery and blocks it back.
Comprehensively beaten! A beautiful delivery. Jarvis pitches it on a length close to off, Mathews plays the trajectory but it nips away ever so slightly to beat the outside edge.
Loopy and full on off, Kusal lunges and defends it solidly.
Shortish and on off, Mathews punches it from the crease to covers. Ervine is standing a bit too deep and hence a run is stolen.
Fuller in length on middle, blocked safely off the front foot.
Full and flighted on off, defended back again by Angelo.
Mathews has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Arm ball delivery around off, skidding down the leg side after pitching, Angelo attempts to flick but misses. It deflects off his pads to fine leg and they take a couple of leg byes.

Pitches it right up there outside off, Mendis drives it off his front foot to mid off.
Angles in a fuller length ball on middle, Mendis leans forward with a vertical bat in defense.
Fullish ball around off, going straight on, Mendis strides forward and across before shouldering arms.

Back of a length delivery outside off, Mathews eases himself on the back foot and punches it in front of square on the off side. The cover-point fielder makes a sliding stop to his left and the batsmen switch ends.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, Mathews offers no shot.
Tossed up ball on off, defended back off the front foot again.
Kusal has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Pulls his length back and lands it close to off, Mendis cuts it off his back foot but finds the point fielder.
A quicker one going down the leg side, Mendis tries to sweep but misses. Chakabva does well to stop it with his pads and parries it towards short leg.

Beaten comprehensively. This one swings away late. Jarvis lands it close to off, forcing the batsman to offer a shot, Mendis leans forward to defend but it moves away late and beats the outside edge.

Kyle Jarvis (12-2-40-0) returns for another spell in the morning session.
FOUR! Mathews goes over the top of the infield! Williams is a bit too full in his length around middle, Mathews takes a big stride forward and lofts it over mid on for a boundary.
Gets on the front foot and blocks it with a straight blade.
Mathews has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Beauty this time! Slows it one in the air and lands it full on off, the ball lands and spins away a bit to open Mathews in his defense. He somehow defends it back.
Quicker arm ball on middle, Mathews defends it from the inner half of his bat.
Flighted full ball on off, Mathews defends it back.
Skipper Sean Williams brings himself into the attack. A slip and short leg in place.
Fullish and outside off, Mendis drives it nice and straight towards mid off.

Lunges to a full ball around off and defends it back calmly.
Goes a bit short on middle, Mathews moves back to stroke it towards mid on.

Quicker through the air, fired in full on off, defended to the off side.
Flighted and too full around off, Mathews defends it off his front foot.
Flatter ball, around middle, Mathews goes on the back foot and defends it to the off side.

Sharp single! A pitched up ball around off, Mathews pushed it with an angled bat to cover-point and ran to the other end. The fielder there was a shade deep and by the time he attacked and released the throw at the striker's end, a single was taken. Albeit Mendis had to dive to make it in.

Hello, folks! Welcome back for the third day of this 'exciting' first Test match between Zimbabwe and Sri Lanka at the ground surrounded by the vintage trees in Harare. The hosts have done well so far to post a sizable first innings' total and also managed to pick a wicket last evening. The nature of the pitch is not too supportive to the bowlers and hence the African team would have to be right on the money this morning as well to apply pressure on the Lankan batting. There is plenty of experience in the visitors' middle order and one cannot write them off just because they haven't been among the runs of late. Let's see which way this Test match moves on the moving day. Stay tuned for more...

So, tomorrow a long day might be in store for the Zimbabwe players as Sri Lanka still have 9 wickets in hand and not a lot of things are happening off the surface. Join us on Tuesday for all the action of Day 3 of this Test match. It will start at 0945 Local (0745 GMT). Till then, cheers and take care!

Sri Lanka came into bat in the latter stages of the day. Their opening stand lasted just 32 runs as Oshada Fernando was sent packing off Donald Tiripano's first ball. After that around 3 overs were bowled before the umpires decided to take the players off the field due to Bad Light.

The Day started on a bad note for the Zimbabwe team as they lost Brendan Taylor. Sean Williams along with Craig Ervine steadied the ship a bit but their wickets fell in consecutive overs which hit the hosts hard. Sikandar Raza and Donald Tiripano added some valuable runs down the order and pushed the Zimbabwe score above the 350-run mark. Embuldeniya ended with his 2nd 5-fer of his Test career while Lakmal and Kumara ended with 3 and 2 wickets respectively.
